title: Vintage 1993 Westwood Campbell Soup 14 Oz. Collectible Mug/Cup- M'm! M'm! Good!
descriptionText: The Vintage 1993 Westwood Campbell Soup 14 Oz. Collectible Mug/Cup is a nostalgic piece of advertising memorabilia featuring the iconic Campbell Soup brand and their classic "M'm! M'm! Good!" slogan. This original and collectible item showcases a vibrant multi-color design specific to the 1993 creation, making it a unique and sought-after piece for enthusiasts of vintage Campbell Soup merchandise. Perfect for collectors of advertising memorabilia or those who appreciate classic soup advertising, this mug/cup is a charming addition to any collection.
